oauth.connectedBody: You can close this tab and return to Naushen Mail.

errors.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again.
errors.connectorUnavailable: The {{provider}} connector is not available in this build.

gmail.missingClient: Google sign-in is not configured in this build. Add your own Google OAuth client ID and secret in Settings → Accounts → OAuth setup (see docs/06-provider-setup.md).
gmail.noRefreshToken: Google did not issue a refresh token. Remove Naushen Mail at myaccount.google.com/permissions and try again.
gmail.missingScope: Naushen Mail needs permission to read and manage your Gmail. Connect again and leave every permission ticked.
gmail.profileFailed: Could not read your Google profile (HTTP {{status}}).
gmail.noEmail: Google did not return an email address for this account.
gmail.authRejected: Google rejected the stored credentials. Sign in again.

outlook.missingClientId: Add your Microsoft Application (client) ID first: Settings → Accounts → OAuth setup.
outlook.noEmail: Microsoft did not return an email address for this account.
outlook.noInbox: Could not find the Inbox folder of this mailbox.
outlook.deltaIncomplete: Outlook delta round did not complete
outlook.categoryOnly: Only Outlook categories can be edited
